oidcBridgeSecret.name: X-OIDC-Bridge-Secret
oidcBridgeSecret.description: Internal server-to-server credential: canonical base64url encoding of 32 random bytes. Never place in iOS, web bundles, cookies, or user JWTs. Requires OIDC_BRIDGE_ENABLED=true and private network access.

deviceUuid.description: Bridge-generated stable random UUID v4 for the browser session.

ipAddress.description: Client address resolved by the trusted bridge; never trust arbitrary forwarded browser headers.

ipAddress.description: Client address resolved by the trusted bridge; never trust arbitrary forwarded browser headers.

subject.description: Immutable existing users.id UUID, normalized to lowercase. Never derive from phone or email.

notBefore.description: Server revocation fence in epoch seconds. The bridge must reject code/session authentication timestamps at or before this value.

subject.description: Immutable existing users.id UUID, normalized to lowercase. Never derive from phone or email.

authTime.description: Unix seconds at successful OTP authentication.

boundEpoch.description: Membership epoch at immutable room registration. Clients must reject sends if it differs from epoch until a reviewed membership migration completes.

roomID.description: Opaque Matrix room ID, including room-version-12 IDs. Clients must verify encryption, membership and device trust with the official SDK; a binding does not attest room security.
